title: MCP++ EncryptedArtifactRef@1
description: Portable reference to a confidential, content-addressed ciphertext artifact and its KeyEnvelope@1. Carries ciphertext CID, AEAD/key-wrap algorithm, recipients and unwrap capabilities, plaintext schema CID, optional protected digest, disclosure and retention policy CIDs, and redaction metadata (plan KD-15). Ciphertext integrity is verifiable without disclosure. Receipts MAY attest use by referencing this ref or its ciphertext_cid without embedding plaintext. Schema acceptance is structural only (ADR-0003). Interfaces: EncryptedArtifactRef@1, KeyEnvelope@1. Normative prose: ipfs_accelerate_py/mcplusplus/docs/spec/cid-native-artifacts.md.
$comment: Interface labels: EncryptedArtifactRef@1, KeyEnvelope@1. Schema marker: mcp++/confidential/encrypted-artifact-ref@1. Nested KeyEnvelope marker: mcp++/confidential/key-envelope@1. Content addressing is not publication; revocation does not erase historical ciphertext (see cid-native-artifacts.md §9).

ciphertext_cid.description: CID of the AEAD ciphertext bytes (ciphertext || authentication tag as defined by algorithm.ciphertext_layout). Integrity of the addressed bytes is verified by content addressing independently of key access. MUST NOT address plaintext.

algorithm.description: Content AEAD and key-wrap parameters used for this artifact. Downgrade to unauthenticated or empty algorithms is forbidden.

key_envelope.description: KeyEnvelope@1: wrapped content keys, recipients, and capability bindings that authorize unwrap. Structural presence does not imply the caller may decrypt.

plaintext_schema_cid.description: CID of the JSON Schema (or type descriptor) that the plaintext MUST satisfy after successful decrypt and decode. Enables structural validation of plaintext without storing it on the ref.

protected_digest.description: Optional authenticated commitment to the plaintext (or canonical plaintext). When present, decryptors MUST verify it after unwrap. Because digests enable offline guessing of low-entropy plaintext, emitters MUST only include this field when disclosure_policy_cid (or the active DisclosurePolicy) permits it. Null or absent means no plaintext digest is published on the ref.

disclosure_policy_cid.description: CID of the DisclosurePolicy document controlling who may observe plaintext, when protected_digest may appear, log/Event-DAG export rules, and authorized redaction. Null means no extra policy document; it does NOT mean open disclosure.

retention_policy_cid.description: CID of the retention / archival policy for ciphertext, key material, and decrypt caches. Null means no extra retention document; local stores MUST still avoid plaintext fallback caches (KD-15).

redaction.description: Redaction metadata for export and projection surfaces. Describes how public views MUST treat this ref; MUST NOT itself contain plaintext.

recipients.description: Optional top-level recipient summary (DID / kid / capability). When present MUST be consistent with key_envelope.wrapped_keys recipients. Prefer the envelope as the authoritative wrap list.

access_caps.description: Optional top-level capability references authorizing decrypt/unwrap. Unioned with key_envelope.access_caps at evaluation time. Transport identity alone never grants unwrap (KD-14).

issuer.description: Optional DID of the principal that sealed this artifact (encryptor / publisher of the ref).

created_at_ms.description: Optional wall-clock mint time (epoch milliseconds). Informational; causal order comes from Event DAG / parents.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization algorithm used when content-addressing this EncryptedArtifactRef object itself. Required on new mints of the ref document.

ref_cid.description: Self-address of this EncryptedArtifactRef once content-addressed. Optional on the wire before addressing; when set MUST match the CID of the canonical ref bytes under the declared canonicalization.

parents.description: Optional causal parents (prior refs, re-wrap events, or Event DAG nodes).

correlation_id.description: Optional non-secret correlation hook. MUST NOT encode plaintext or key material.

label.description: Optional non-secret human label or classification tag (e.g. workload id class). MUST NOT embed secrets or recoverable plaintext.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative annotations. MUST NOT carry plaintext, raw DEKs, unwrapped keys, or a second algorithm/envelope that contradicts top-level fields.

cid.description: IPFS CID. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

hexDigest.description: Lowercase or uppercase hex digest (sha2-256 = 64 hex chars; longer only for explicitly larger hashes).

contentAead.description: Closed set of content AEAD algorithms for new mints. Authenticated encryption is mandatory.

keyWrapAlg.description: Closed set of content-key wrap algorithms for new mints.

ciphertextLayout.description: How nonce/IV and tag are packaged under ciphertext_cid.

content_aead.description: AEAD used to encrypt the canonical plaintext bytes.

key_wrap.description: Default key-wrap algorithm for wrapped content keys. Per-recipient overrides MAY appear on wrapped_keys[].key_wrap.

ciphertext_layout.description: Layout of bytes addressed by ciphertext_cid. Default for new mints: nonce_prepended_ciphertext_tag.

aead_nonce_b64url.description: AEAD nonce/IV when ciphertext_layout is nonce_separate_ciphertext_tag or raw_ciphertext_tag. MUST be unique per content key. Forbidden to reuse a nonce with the same content key.

aead_tag_length.description: Authentication tag length in bytes. Fixed at 16 for the closed AEAD set.

hkdf_info.description: Optional HKDF info/context label binding the content key derivation (e.g. mcp++/confidential/content-key@1).

aad_binding.description: What is bound as AEAD additional authenticated data (AAD). Prevents cut-and-paste of ciphertext under a different schema or ref.

alg.description: Hash algorithm over the digest input. sha2-256 only for new mints (ADR-0002 alignment).

digest.description: Digest bytes as unpadded base64url or hex.

binding.description: Whether the digest covers raw decrypted bytes or mcpp-jcs-v1 canonical plaintext. Default for structured JSON plaintext: canonical-plaintext-mcpp-jcs-v1.

mode.description: How projections and logs MUST treat this artifact. commitment-only and public-ciphertext-ref allow publishing ciphertext_cid / ref_cid without plaintext.

public_fields.description: Optional allow-list of fields safe to echo on public surfaces when mode permits. protected_digest only when disclosure policy allows.

redaction_receipt_cid.description: Optional CID of a redaction / export receipt attesting what was stripped.

notes.description: Non-secret operator note. MUST NOT contain plaintext fragments.

cid.description: Proof or delegation CID when kind is ucan_proof_cid or delegation_cid.

resource.description: Resource binding (typically ciphertext_cid, ref_cid, or a CID-prefix).

recipient.description: Recipient principal DID authorized to hold a wrapped content key.

recipient_kid.description: Key id of the recipient public key used for wrap.

capability_cid.description: Optional UCAN/delegation CID that further constrains this recipient's unwrap rights.

recipient.description: DID of the principal for whom content_key is wrapped.

recipient_kid.description: Recipient key id used for this wrap.

recipient_public_key_b64url.description: Optional embedded recipient public key (e.g. X25519 32-byte key, unpadded base64url). Prefer did:key resolution when available.

key_wrap.description: Per-recipient key-wrap override; null means use algorithm.key_wrap.

wrapped_key_b64url.description: Wrapped content key ciphertext (and wrap-layer tag if applicable), unpadded base64url. NEVER the raw content key.

wrap_nonce_b64url.description: Nonce for the wrap-layer AEAD when required by key_wrap.

ephemeral_public_key_b64url.description: Ephemeral X25519 public key for ECDH-based wraps.

capability_cid.description: Optional capability/delegation CID that must still validate at unwrap time for this recipient.

expires_at_ms.description: Optional wall-clock expiry for this wrap entry. After expiry, unwrap MUST fail closed even if ECDH would succeed. Does not erase ciphertext_cid.

content_key_id.description: Opaque identifier for the content encryption key (DEK) used under ciphertext_cid. Used for rotation and log correlation without revealing key bytes.

wrapped_keys.description: One or more recipient-wrapped copies of the content key. Empty array is invalid: a sealed artifact MUST name at least one unwrap path.

access_caps.description: Capability references that authorize unwrap in addition to possession of a recipient private key. Evaluated fail-closed at decrypt time.

epoch.description: Key-envelope epoch for rotation. Higher epoch on a superseding ref indicates a re-wrap; historical refs retain their original envelope bytes.

supersedes_content_key_id.description: Optional prior content_key_id this envelope replaces after rotation. Does not invalidate already-distributed plaintext.

revocation_binding.description: Optional binding to revocation discovery for unwrap capabilities or named key epochs. See honest revocation semantics in the spec.

mode.description: How unwrap revocation is discovered. none means only wrap expiry / missing keys apply; it does NOT claim irrevocable access forever if outer UCAN policy still revokes.

ledger_or_registry.description: Logical revocation ledger/registry id when mode is delegation_ledger.

revocation_policy_cid.description: Optional CID of a document describing which RevocationRecord@1 sources are authoritative for this envelope's access_caps.
